title: Special Executive Programme In Strategic Leadership
description: The Special Executive Program in Strategic Leadership aims to chalk out the role played by the senior leadership in shaping the future of an organization so that learners can be trained as successful leaders of the future.
longDescription: Explore the dynamics of effective leadership and its critical role in shaping strategic direction and organizational success. This program offers mid-to-senior level executives the tools to enhance their leadership skills, emphasizing strategic thinking, team dynamics, and ethical responsibility in today’s complex business landscape.
courseDetails: The course enables students to understand the nuances of effective leadership through comprehensive content, including an exploration of leadership theories, stages, and the relationships between leaders and teams. Participants will engage in practical assessments of corporate objectives and strategies, develop crisis management skills, and learn techniques to navigate change effectively. The curriculum culminates in fostering an ethical leadership framework that prioritizes sustainability and corporate social responsibility.
